created_by: FlameLens data team, with an SI tool
si_use: An SI tool (Claude) wrote and ran the scripts that downloaded NASA's files, joined the CFI data summary spreadsheet to the experimental table by Flex Number and copied each cell. In version 2 it also added, as new tests, the 148 Flex Numbers the spreadsheet lists and PSI's table does not, after checking that none is held for any investigation, and copied their conditions and results cell by cell. Cool-flame, no-ignition and droplet (liquid fuel) claims come from fixed phrase rules applied to NASA's comments; the SI tool read every match and the judgements it made (matches left out, cells withheld, repeats) are listed with reasons in REPORT.md. A script checked every claim against the spreadsheet. No value was generated or estimated. The team's six members have checked it. Version 4: the same kind of script copied NASA's history files (droplet, visible flame and cool-flame diameters) into curves, thinned by a written rule, and the test sheets into claims, matching each file to a test by Flex Number.
summary: Burning-rate constants, extinction diameters and starting diameters for the CFI droplet tests, from NASA's data summary spreadsheet, and 148 CFI tests that PSI's table does not list, with their conditions. 1787 claims on 218 tests (148 new).
